breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradictory boundary conditions (Dirichlet and periodic). It resolved the issue by only including the Dirichlet condition ('Enforce Dirichlet boundary conditions only: set u=0 on all four edges'), which aligns perfectly with the ground truth prompt that removed the erroneous periodic condition.
